name: Atlassian (Jira, Confluence)
summary: Self-serve: create an OAuth 2.0 (3LO) app in the developer console and turn on sharing. Users see an 'unreviewed app' warning unless you go through Marketplace approval.
scenario: An agent that reads and updates Jira issues and Confluence pages for users in other Atlassian sites.

composio.note: Check the Composio managed OAuth directory for the Jira and Confluence toolkits.

policyAndDomain.detail: The management page doesn't state requirements for enabling sharing; developers report a personal data declaration step.

userCapBeforeApproval.detail: No user cap mentioned; each user installs via the authorization URL.

adminApproval.detail: Apps install per user via the authorization link; no site-admin step is described on the page checked.

appReview.detail: Not needed to share. Optional approval through the Marketplace listing process removes the unreviewed-app warning.

time.note: No wait to share. Marketplace approval timing was not checked.

nextStep: Open the Atlassian developer console, create an OAuth 2.0 integration, add Jira/Confluence API scopes and your callback URL, then enable sharing under Distribution.

prerequisites.text: An Atlassian account and a test Jira or Confluence Cloud site.

steps.title: Create an OAuth 2.0 integration
steps.detail: Profile icon → Developer console → Create → OAuth 2.0 integration.

steps.title: Add API scopes and callback URL
steps.detail: Under Permissions add the Jira and/or Confluence APIs and scopes; under Authorization add your callback URL.

steps.title: Enable sharing
steps.detail: Distribution → Enable sharing, then copy the Authorization URL from Authorization → OAuth 2.0 (3LO) → Configure.

steps.title: Install with a second account
steps.detail: Open the authorization URL with another Atlassian account and confirm site selection and API calls (use the accessible-resources call to find the cloud ID).

steps.title: Optional: request Marketplace approval
steps.detail: Follow the Marketplace listing steps to get reviewed; an informative listing is not required to submit.

review.summary: Optional. Unreviewed apps can be shared, but users see a warning.
triggers: Wanting to remove the unreviewed warning or list on Marketplace
reviewersCheck: Not described on the page checked
review.meanwhile: Share the authorization URL with users directly.

blockers.issue: Existing users lose access after you add scopes.
blockers.fix: Changing scopes requires users to consent again; plan scope changes and prompt reconnects.
Uninstall it everywhere first; installed apps can't be deleted.

nuances.text: Enabling sharing does not list the app on the Marketplace; 3LO apps can only have informational listings.
Apps install per user, so every user must go through the authorization link.

uncertainties: Exact scope names and the personal data reporting requirement were not confirmed against official pages in this pass.

sources.title: Atlassian community: Personal data reporting for OAuth 2.0 apps
